name: Kira Villanueva-Karunaratne-Owusu
location: The Underworld - B3, near sub-level access near LaSalle and Congress
description: Mazhar has navigated the tunnels beneath GLMZ for forty years. His augmented sonar implant maps passages in real-time. He lost his left leg to a cave-in and uses a hand-carved crutch from a pre-collapse beam.

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Hispanic/Latin American with significant South Asian and Sub-Saharan African ancestry. The genetic blend creates warm-toned brown skin with subtle undertones reflecting the tri-continental mix—Latin American warmth, South Asian depth, and African richness layered together.
physical_description.build: Lean, weathered frame with pronounced musculature in shoulders and right leg from decades of crutch-assisted locomotion. Left side noticeably atrophied below the hip.
physical_description.hair_color: Steel gray with remnants of black at the roots
physical_description.hair_style: Short, thinning, swept back from forehead
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with faint amber undertone (sonar implant neural feedback)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-to-deep brown with ashy undertones from forty years underground, devoid of sun exposure. The base tone reflects the Latin American and South Asian heritage with Sub-Saharan depth.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined, deep creases around eyes and mouth reflecting mixed ancestry features. Scarring across the right temple and jawline from tunnel debris. Calloused hands, especially right palm and fingers. Perpetual dust coating on exposed skin.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running 15cm down the left inner thigh where the leg was amputated below the knee, edges slightly keloid
Burn scar across right forearm (10cm) from an early tunnel collapse in 2186
Tattoo on inner left wrist: Bore Rat symbol (stylized tunnel opening) in faded black ink, dating to early crew days
Deep laceration scar on right cheekbone, partially hidden by stubble
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. The sonar implant is subcutaneous (mounted at the base of the skull, behind the left ear), detectable only by touch as a slightly raised ridge under skin.
physical_description.posture_movement: Asymmetrical gait reliant on a hand-carved wooden crutch (fashioned from a pre-collapse I-beam salvage). Leans heavily to the right, shoulders twisted slightly compensatory. Moves with deliberate, economical motion—no wasted energy. When stationary, shifts weight onto right leg and crutch; left hip remains rigid. Grips crutch with white-knuckle tension when navigating uneven terrain.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 utilitarian—worn canvas cargo pants with multiple patch repairs, reinforced knees and thighs in darker fabric. Left pant leg pinned/sewn shut below the knee. Thermal undershirt (faded tan, holes in sleeves patched with duct tape). Heavy canvas duster jacket, dirt-gray, with deep pockets stuffed with tunnel navigation tools (chalk, rope, hand-drawn maps). Rope-soled boots, heavily scuffed; right boot reinforced. No corpo branding, no chrome jewelry. Carries a weathered leather satchel with sonar mapping equipment and tunnel documentation.
